metadata.name: Nexora AI
metadata.description: Nexora is an intelligent AI writing assistant, document-analysis engine, and multimodal PDF reasoning workspace.

capabilities.capability: Extracts text, outlines complex documents, summarizes lengthy research papers, and answers targeted contextual queries.
Formats, extracts, and standardizes citations for reporting from court judgments across Bluebook, OSCOLA, AIR, SCC, PLD, and SCMR formats.
Parses handwritten notes, flowcharts, infographics, diagrams, and visual receipts.
Native fluency in English, Urdu (اردو), Hindi (हिंदी), Arabic (العربية), Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ), and 40+ global languages.
Exports documents to PDF, Markdown, and TXT; supports realistic voice read-aloud with customizable speeds.

resources.resource: Overview of Nexora AI features, workflows, and instant workspace launch.
Markdown-formatted LLM index file following llmstxt.org specifications.
